definitions.gloss: regional revitalization; community development; local revitalization
definitions.explanation: Efforts to revive or develop declining rural or local communities through economic, cultural, or social initiatives. A major policy topic in Japan due to rural depopulation.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}おこしに{取|と}り{組|く}む。
{地域|ちいき}おこし{協力隊|きょうりょくたい}として{移住|いじゅう}した。
examples.english: I moved there as a member of the regional revitalization cooperation corps.

examples.japanese: {特産品|とくさんひん}を{活|い}かした{地域|ちいき}おこしが{全国|ぜんこく}で{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Regional revitalization efforts that leverage local specialty products are spreading nationwide.

notes:
Composed of {地域|ちいき} (region, area) + おこし (raising up, reviving — from {起|お}こす). A key concept in contemporary Japanese society, where many rural areas face severe population decline ({過疎化|かそか}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地域|ちいき}おこしに{取|と}り{組|く}む: to work on regional revitalization
- {地域|ちいき}おこし{協力隊|きょうりょくたい}: regional revitalization cooperation corps (a government program)
- {地域|ちいき}おこしイベント: community revitalization event

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {地域|ちいき}おこし{協力隊|きょうりょくたい} is a Japanese government program established in 2009 that sends urban residents to rural areas for 1-3 years to help with local development. Participants often engage in tourism promotion, agriculture, and community building.

RELATED WORDS:
- {町|まち}おこし: town revitalization — same concept at the town level
- {村|むら}おこし: village revitalization — same concept at the village level
- {地方創生|ちほうそうせい}: regional revitalization — the formal government policy term
